subject: Leadership briefing: mid-quarter resource realignments + dependency asks
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos@hannahtech.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@hannahtech.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership briefing: mid-quarter resource realignments + dependency asks

Team —

Following our weekly leadership sync, attached is a short readout for the mid-quarter OKR health check and a proposed reallocation of a portion of backend infra capacity to the latency initiative (slides attached). Two things I need from owners by end of day Wednesday:

1) Confirmation of scope changes: if your initiative will shrink (explicitly call out which KRs will be deprioritized) respond with the updated accept/reject line.

2) Concrete dependency commitments: we need a committed owner and ETA for the two outstanding items blocking the HannahTech pilot (listed on slide 3). The pilot is time-boxed for Nov 8 and procurement needs to finalize the SOW.

Quick context highlights:
- OKR health: 3 on-track, 6 at-risk, 2 behind. The at-risk items are concentrated in model deployment and e2e latency.
- Proposal: shift 2 FTE-equivalent infra run-hours from noncritical experiments into the latency optimization pod for the next 6 weeks. This is a targeted re-scope, not a hiring move.
- Risk: if procurement or security evidence for HannahTech is delayed past Oct 29, we will miss the pilot window and may need to push Q4 milestones.

Attachments: 2026Q4_OKR_readout_slides.pdf, HannahTech_MA_plan_v2.xlsx, procurement_checklist.pdf

Please reply inline with either APPROVE-SCOPE or DECLINE-SCOPE, plus the dependency owner for each line on slide 3. I will collate and present a final ask in tomorrow's exec check-in.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership briefing: mid-quarter resource realignments + dependency asks

Stephanie —

APPROVE-SCOPE for the latency reallocation. I support moving the 2 FTE-equivalent hours for the next 6 weeks; we already have overlap in infra roadmaps that will allow the shift with minimal disruption.

Dependency commitments (from my side):
- VPN access gating for HannahTech internal endpoints — Owner: Michael Grant, ETA: 2026-10-26 EOD.
- SOC evidence export: I will confirm with Security and post the evidence bundle to the drive by 2026-10-27 noon.

A couple of asks for procurement: Carlos, can your team confirm the final SOW signatory list by Oct 23? Procurement details in spreadsheet look incomplete.

—Vivek

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos@hannahtech.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership briefing: mid-quarter resource realignments + dependency asks

Thanks — assigning owners and marking ETAs below.

- VPN access gating for HannahTech internal endpoints — Owner: Michael Grant (infra-networks), ETA: 2026-10-26 17:00 PT. I will open a change window on Oct 25; change ticket INF-4829 created.
- Test token provisioning for pilot integration — Owner: Laura Bennett (platform), ETA: 2026-10-28 12:00 PT.

Note: reallocation approved on my side provided we preserve capacity for the critical nightly rebuilds (I will schedule a shorter rebuild slot during the six-week window).

Attachments: INF-4829-change-request.txt (text/plain)

Michael
Senior Engineering Manager

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos@hannahtech.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership briefing: mid-quarter resource realignments + dependency asks

APPROVE-SCOPE with one qualification: we will deprioritize the experimental zero-downtime snapshot work (KR 2.4) for the duration of the reallocation. That reduces our risk surface and frees up two engineer-weeks. Confirming owner for test token provisioning (me) with ETA Oct 28 as Michael noted.

Operational note for Stephanie: can you confirm how you want to surface these temporary KR changes in the OKR tracker? I can update statuses but prefer we append an explicit "temporary re-scope" note so QBR reviewers see it was a deliberate tradeoff.

Laura
Director, Platform

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos@hannahtech.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@hannahtech.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership briefing: mid-quarter resource realignments + dependency asks

Thanks all — I will: 
- Update the OKR tracker with a temporary re-scope flag and a short rationale (by 2026-10-21 16:00 PT).
- Send the standard procurement evidence packet to HannahTech procurement (expect to hit procurement@hannahtech.com with the package and DocuSign link by 2026-10-22 morning).

Carlos: please confirm whether the procurement team can accept our evidence bundle format or if they need anything additional (security questionnaire answers, IP addendums, or third-party attestation).

If there are no further comments I will mark this readout as APPROVED-SCOPE and proceed to lock the reallocation for the next six weeks.

-naomi
Head of Customer Success
